query: INSERT INTO source_links(id,workspace_id,issue_id,url,title) SELECT input.id,$1,input.issue_id,input.url,$5 FROM unnest($2::uuid[],$3::uuid[],$4::text[]) AS input(id,issue_id,url) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM source_links s WHERE s.workspace_id=$1 AND s.issue_id=input.issue_id AND s.url=input.url AND s.title=$5) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
